_comment: Acid-base indicator dyes (src/db/seed.rs, src/chem_db.rs). Each entry is a pair of species records with their real structures (SMILES, formula checked by tests/open_items_b.rs) and one acid-base site on the acid form; the equilibrium row `acid <=> base + H+` is generated from that site (chem_db::record_acid_equilibria), not written by hand. pKa values: the transition midpoints tabulated for these dyes at 25 C (Bates, Cohn / CRC Handbook indicator tables). The enthalpy of ionisation is the class estimate of the ionised group (phenol ~ +25 kJ/mol, carboxylic and azonium ~ 0), tier Estimated. The engine's species are the balanced one-proton forms of the dye (the lactone / sultone / azo tautomers are not separate species): the colours of both forms are optical records (data/optics_seed.json). The pKa of a dye is not predictable from the structure classes of src/pka_structure.rs (extended pi systems, tautomerism), so it stays tabulated.
